definitions.source: Byte-pinned original JavaScript in an offline VM. Two first-of-month Binance BTCUSDT scopes start flat at 06:00 UTC and stop at 10:00 UTC. The separate native host fixture shows the omitted default balance 10,000 USDT, 200ms completion for the probed account, position and market order calls and no time advancement for setters. The source direction controls futures side even when the order is sent via the opposite Buy or Sell method. Sources use no K-line reads on their exercised main paths.
definitions.random: Original Math.random seeds were unspecified. The three prespecified xorshift32 seeds produce initial uniforms below 0.5. Each seed and its exact antithetic bit stream are kept, exposing both authored sides. Each path is an explicitly labeled historical stochastic sensitivity.
definitions.fill: At API completion, use the latest recorded bid or ask available by capture-local timestamp and require full order size at top of book. Quotes older than five seconds or size shortfalls stop the entire path. All modeled orders are marketable. The primary model adds no extra delay beyond measured 200ms host calls. An independent repeat reruns the entire causal path with 200ms additional submission delay per market order. Same-price executable size for the next 100ms is reported as a separate diagnostic.
definitions.cash: Use historical 0.04% taker fee, weighted futures cost basis and exchange funding rate. Gross uses observed side prices. Source floating position profit uses observed last trade, consistent with a native last-based position result, while marked drawdown uses recorded Binance derivatives mark prices. Every settlement has an official venue schedule/rate and nearby checksum-bound minute mark.
definitions.scope_limits: 0ms and 200ms added delay are benchmark assumptions and do not reproduce queue priority, latency guarantees, market impact or hidden liquidity. Price and quoted size are real recorded observations, while all fills and results are repo-local models. Keep the settings and timing labels attached to each benchmark.

reproduction: Run the native semantics fixture in the restricted offline engine against the pinned #1942 tape. Stage the immutable archive source and timestamped BBO and mark snapshots. Replay twice in separate offline processes and compare byte-identical receipts. Use the independent Decimal verifier to derive all rows.
